aiSetup.instructionsBody: Privately add GEMINI_API_KEY and a supported AI_MODEL to the server environment. The default endpoint is Google Gemini’s OpenAI-compatible endpoint. After completing the reviews below, set AI_STUDY_BUDDY_ENABLED and DATA_COLLECTION_ENABLED to true and restart or redeploy. See AI-SETUP.md in the project.

detail.multiClassUnsupported: Multi-class exams are not supported on this screen.
detail.tooManyRecords: Too many records; an incomplete list is not displayed.
detail.marksHelp: Enter A for absent. Marks are whole numbers; complete every subject. Use Tab to move between fields.
detail.rankHelp: Equal totals share a competition rank; absent students are unranked.

form.writeDisabled: Exam writes are disabled for safety.
form.bandsHelp: Review and edit the suggested bands. A 0% band is required; below a subject pass mark is FAIL.
form.confirmReview: I reviewed subjects, pass marks and grades
form.created: Created. Open the exam in the list.

publish.note: Publishing locks marks. Only saved results are published; unentered students are not automatically included.

classEdit.help: Past records are retained; academic year cannot be changed.

review.title: Legacy records review
review.previewNote: Preview only; no records are created, linked or changed.
review.matchNote: Exact name or phone matches are suggestions, not confirmed identities. No match is not proof of a new person. A legacy account phone may belong to the student, not the guardian.
review.feeNote: Legacy fees use poisha and may have non-cash methods. All amounts, methods, receipts and invoices require review before conversion to the new whole-taka cash ledger. Legacy records remain untouched.
review.heading: Legacy students
review.loadError: Could not safely load all records; please retry.

link.note: Only the identity link is recorded; payments and the legacy portal are not migrated.
link.writeDisabled: Link writes are disabled for safety.
link.reasonLabel: How identity was verified (at least 5 characters)
link.confirmReview: I verified the identities and confirm the link

msg.draftSaved: Draft saved. Select Publish below to make it public.
msg.tooLarge: The PDF must be at most 4 MB.
msg.invalid: Enter a Bangla title and a valid PDF of at most 4 MB.
msg.saveFailed: Could not save. Check your connection and try again.
msg.changeFailed: Could not save the change. Please retry.

confirm.withdraw: Withdraw this sheet? Downloaded copies cannot be recalled.
confirm.publish: Publish for everyone? Confirm it contains no private information.

sheet.title: Public lecture sheets
sheet.steps: 1. Enter details and PDF  2. Save draft  3. Publish from the list below.
sheet.warning: Warning: once published anyone can view and download the file without login.
sheet.warningNote: Do not upload student or private information. Downloaded or cached copies cannot be recalled. This is separate from private batch materials. Use only trusted, security-checked PDFs; there is no automatic malware scan.

sheets.loadError: Could not load the information. Refresh the page.

msg.csvTooLarge: CSV must be at most 256 KB.
msg.csvLoaded: CSV loaded. Verify the answer key before saving.
msg.csvFailed: Could not read CSV. Check headers, four options and correct 1–4.
msg.incomplete: Complete the title, subject, each question and four options.
msg.saveFailed: Could not save. Check your connection and try again.

confirm.publish: Have you verified the answer key? Everyone can take this test after publication.

practice.title: Public practice tests
practice.notice: Enter Unicode questions or import UTF-8 CSV. Guests can take published tests. Verify every answer before publishing.
practice.csvRules: Save from Excel as CSV UTF-8. Use the exact header below; correct is the option number 1, 2, 3 or 4. Maximum 30 questions.
practice.csvQuote: Quote cells containing commas or newlines. Importing replaces the questions currently in the form.

exam.resultError: Could not get the result. Please try again.
exam.notice: This is a practice test. You can submit unanswered questions.
exam.saveConsent: Save my result (requires student login and linked profile; obtain guardian permission where applicable).
exam.saveConsentNote: If not selected, this result will not be stored in an account.
exam.savedToProfile: Result saved to your student profile.
exam.saveFailedRequirements: Result was not saved. A student login, linked profile and enabled data setting are required.
exam.notSaved: This result was not saved to an account.
exam.snapshotNote: This is a snapshot of performance on this test; ask a teacher for a fuller assessment.

history.title: Saved practice results
history.notLinked: No student profile is linked to this account. Contact the institution.

importReview.title: Spreadsheet preview
importReview.subtitle: Preview first; data is saved only after your explicit confirmation.
importReview.tab: Tab name (optional; blank uses first tab)
importReview.limits: Up to 2 MB, 30 tabs, 2,000 rows and 40 columns per tab. CSV does not contain colors.
importReview.safe: Preview and validation do not save students or payments. Review all selected records and ambiguous markers before importing.

issues.red_payment_text: Red receipt or amount text — meaning unknown
issues.uncertain_color: Some colors could not be resolved
issues.varying_amounts: Amounts differ between months — review fee history
issues.shared_receipt: Receipt appears under multiple students — review

warnings.other_tabs_not_scanned: Some tabs could not be checked for receipt conflicts.
warnings.csv_colors_lost: CSV has no color information; compare with the screenshot.
warnings.incomplete_pair: A final row is missing its pair.
warnings.conditional_formatting: Conditional formatting exists; displayed colors may be incomplete. Check the original sheet.

errors.format: Only XLSX or CSV is accepted.
errors.unsafe_xlsx: The file exceeds safe archive limits.
errors.sheet: The named tab was not found.
errors.header: Name, Admission and January–December headers were not found.

importReview.unavailable: Preview unavailable; check the class and database connection.
importReview.matchCapped: Possible matches were capped; some may not be shown.

draft.note: The draft contains only marker decisions and a verification hash, not names, phones or the spreadsheet. Re-preview the same file, tab and class before loading. Review the fresh candidate matches again. This does not import.
draft.bad: The draft is invalid or does not match this preview.

totals.invalid: Raw amounts could not be safely totaled.
totals.raw: Raw numeric amounts: {all} Taka. {count} cells with numeric receipt and amount total {matched} Taka. This is not the approved import total.

importDecisions.title: Review decisions
importDecisions.intro: Choices are not automatically saved. You can download a review draft from this page. Review each ambiguous marker before importing.
importDecisions.different: Verified: different from the existing student
importDecisions.hold: Possibly on hold—verify period and reason
importDecisions.candidate: Possible matches only; no automatic linking or merging.

importCommit.title: Import review
importCommit.safetyNote: Only selected and confirmed rows will be imported. Unknown red colors, Done and A are never interpreted automatically. Holds, absences, waivers and advances are not processed yet; skip affected students for now. Existing records are not merged automatically.
importCommit.draftNote: The form draft contains names, phones and personal information. Store it securely; it is not saved automatically. Download marker decisions separately above.
importCommit.approvalNote: Unknown payment dates and receivers remain unknown. This approval is valid for 10 minutes.
importCommit.writesDisabled: Import writes are disabled. After verifying the real sheet and backup, an administrator can set CENTER_IMPORT_WRITE_ENABLED=true.

undo.note: Undo marks unchanged batch students as removed and voids payments with a reason; it does not delete financial records. Undo is blocked if records changed or have dependencies.
undo.confirm: I am sure I want to undo this batch

codes.ROW_NOT_CONFIRMED: The student record is not confirmed
codes.MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELDS: Fill in the name, guardian, phone, admission date and fee history
codes.RED_ROW_UNRESOLVED: The red row still has no decision
codes.RED_TEXT_UNRESOLVED: The red text still has no decision
codes.COLOR_UNRESOLVED: An uncertain color has not been checked
codes.SHARED_RECEIPT_UNREVIEWED: Decide what the shared receipt means
codes.FORMULA_UNSUPPORTED: A formula cannot be imported directly
codes.PAYMENT_TEXT_UNRESOLVED: Decide what the red payment text means
codes.FILL_UNRESOLVED: Decide what the red cell means
codes.CELL_UNRESOLVED: Decide what the marker or the incomplete cell means
codes.NUMERIC_AMOUNT_NEEDS_REVIEW: An amount or a receipt is present, so the cell cannot be dropped as due
codes.COLORS_UNCONFIRMED: Confirm the colors in the file against the original sheet
codes.INCOMPLETE_PAIR: The last row pair is incomplete
codes.ROW_SET_MISMATCH: The sheet rows changed; run a new preview
codes.NOTHING_SELECTED: Select at least one student to import
codes.DUPLICATE_IN_DRAFT: The name and the phone are the same; tell them apart in the preview
codes.SHARED_RECEIPT_UNCONFIRMED: One receipt appears under several students; confirm it
codes.PLAN_INVALID: Check the records, dates, phones, fee history or correction fields
codes.CLASS_YEAR_MISMATCH: The class and the academic year do not match
codes.PREVIEW_CLASS_MISMATCH: The import class is not the class of the earlier preview; preview again with the right class
codes.MATCH_LIMIT: There are too many possible matches; they need a separate check
codes.POSSIBLE_MATCH_NEEDS_REVIEW: Check the possible existing student and decide it is different, or skip the row if it is the same record
codes.INVALID_DRAFT: The input is not in the right shape

importCommit.selectedSummary: Selected: {count} of {total}. A guardian name and an admission date are required for every student.
importCommit.feeHistoryHelp: Write month:amount in each student fee history, for example 1:3000,6:2000. Check the first month and every change; the fee is never guessed from a payment amount.
importCommit.draftInvalid: The draft is invalid, or it belongs to another file or tab.
importCommit.includeStudent: Include this student in the import
importCommit.reviewedStudent: I have checked this student name, phone, dates, first month and the whole fee history.
importCommit.colorsVerified: I have checked the CSV or conditional colors against the original sheet or its photo.
importCommit.sharedAllowed: Where one receipt covers several students, I have checked it and I allow it.
importCommit.checkSummary: Validated: {students} students, {payments} payments, {batches} batches. Total: {total} Taka. Skipped: {skipped}. Payment date unknown: {unknownDates}.
importCommit.confirmCheck: I have checked the preview and the selected records, and I approve the import into the database.
importCommit.runRetry: If it stopped part way, validate and run again with the same selection and data; the earlier batches are not created twice.
